fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) issued $2.0B new bonds to fund Silicon Laboratories acquisition; currently valued at $311.49 with fair value $435.69, representing 29% undervaluation.
fields.summary_ko.1: TXN achieved 94.58% total shareholder return over past year; 30-day return 5.63%, 90-day return 11.89%.
fields.summary_ko.2: 300mm analog manufacturing capacity expansion cycle constraining near-term free cash flow, but expected to strengthen long-term competitiveness through cost efficiency improvements and margin expansion.
